results.title: Guinea illegal gold mining crackdown sparks clashes, kills 10 - Mining.com.au
results.snippet: Violent clashes over a ban on illegal gold mining in northeastern Guinea have left 10 people dead and 13 others injured, according to a government statement. On 2 November, Guinea banned artisanal gold mining in Siguiri as part of efforts to curb unregulated mining activities and environmental damage.
